text.card: A red giant 5,727 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 1.55 solar masses and 14.7 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,933 K at its surface.
